actions.action: Install a plug-in outlet timer and set the grow light to 14 hours per day
Lower the grow light to 6–12 inches above the rosettes, checking the light's instructions
If leaves bleach or crisp, raise the light 2 inches
Check soil dryness with a finger 2 inches deep before watering
Water slowly at the soil edge only when fully dry, avoiding the leaves

reason: The answer correctly names insufficient light as the cause and farina as normal. Its fix only boosts the grow light, without the window or sun exposure the thread recommended, so it is only partly matched. Nothing it suggests is harmful.
